summary: Quiet residential kerb, but houses sit 13-14m back on this side.
reasons: Steep, no stopping signs at north end

best_section.where: West kerb of Kew Street between the two mid-block houses, away from the junction signs

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 13-14m from the kerb on this side, and more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential street; room for a van beside the lane, a few cars park along it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street between two through roads.
drivers.convention: No camping convention; occasional cars park along it.

flags: Steep: about 5.7% grade here, 12.2% max over the stretch
No Stopping Any Time signs at the ends of the stretch
sun_shade: Garden and street trees give partial shade; open to the afternoon sun from the west.
cannot_judge: Exact extent of the no-stopping zones
